purpose: same-problem method competition plus implementation/evidence consistency learning

Q1.S001: stateful/streaming fatigue emphasis and exact-baseline comparison
Q1.S003: adaptive three-stage window narrative but printed fixed-window code
Q1.S004: fixed 10 s overlapping-window amplitude/mean surrogate + startup trigonometric prediction
Q1.selection_rule: Keep exact batch rainflow as gold standard. Window surrogates must pass synthetic-cycle scale/boundary tests; prefer stateful online cycle accounting when physical cumulative damage is required.

Q2.S003: segmented high-order physics-inspired nonlinear regression with unit/scaling risks
Q2.S004: physics-first torque/thrust formula + residual-driven lag/scale correction
Q2.selection_rule: Start with semantically correct, unit-consistent physics. Add small residual/lag calibration only on training blocks and validate on untouched turbines/time. A correction factor must represent the physical process it is named after.

Q3.S003: Pareto/region/LSTM/MPC narrative but static-SLSQP-like printed code
Q3.S004: single-objective constrained genetic algorithm on power-allocation weights
Q3.selection_rule: Use an explicit constrained optimizer/GA as reproducible benchmark before RL. For GA report objective implementation, feasibility after genetic operators, latency distribution, and solution-quality variability across seeds.

Q4.S003: Kalman/delay/robust-MPC/PSO narrative with missing implementation evidence
Q4.S004: Kalman vs moving average/SG + delay detection + SMA/ARIMA/LSTM + five-treatment downstream ablation
Q4.selection_rule: S004 has the strongest staged evidence design among these texts, but implementation must reset per-entity filter states, use unit-aware delay thresholds, preserve treatment labels, and report fatigue-vs-variance trade-offs rather than an overall-win claim.

figure_design_lesson: Across S001-S004, a strong answer follows mechanism/baseline → diagnostics → correction/optimization → direct constraint/runtime evidence → independent robustness/ablation. Figure quantity is secondary to claim coverage.
